Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the wanted rebooking rate, the lapsed limit, the warning days, the reply days and the wanted review average.
Check Team, Services and Service Cycles. They hold the people, the 20 services and the usual days between visits for each service, with the grace days.
Keep Clients and Appointments up to date. Days since the last visit, the lapsed flags and the rebooking state calculate themselves.

Use the 14 calculators to test a rebooking target, a lost fill, a win-back offer, a reward, a promotion and a reply order.

Prepaid packs with sessions left and value owed
One row per prepaid pack or series sold; sessions left, value left (a liability until used), days to expiry and the pack state fill in by themselves.
Every pack session as it is used
One row per session taken from a pack: the date, the pack, the service and the technician; the value used, the sessions left after it and the phones fill in by themselves.
The five prepaid packs with the sessions and the price of each; the packs sold page and the price tool use them.
One row per member: plan, monthly fee, included sessions and the next charge (a membership is a monthly fee with included sessions); billed to date, unused sessions and failed charges fill in.
The four monthly plans with the fee and the sessions included each month; the membership tools use them.
Monthly membership charges and failed ones
One row per monthly charge: the member, the amount and the state; a failed charge shows the days late and the next action, and a retry date is written when one is set.
Included and used sessions of each member by month
One row per member and month: the sessions included and the sessions used; the unused sessions, the share used and the client fill in by themselves.
Gift card register with balances and expiry

One row per gift card: the buyer, the holder, the face value, what was redeemed and the balance; days to expiry and the card state fill in. An unused balance is owed to the holder until the card ends.
Gift card redemptions and the balance after each
One row per gift card use: the card, the date, the amount and the visit it paid for; the balance after the use and the phones fill in by themselves.
Packs and gift cards that end soon
One row per pack or card close to its end: the value left, who follows up and whether a reminder was sent; the days left and the urgency fill in by themselves.
Prepaid balance owed to clients by month
One row per month for packs and gift cards: value sold, used and expired and the balance still owed; the change and the prepaid share fill in. A membership is a monthly fee, not a balance.
Offers to renew a pack or series
One row per renewal offer: the client, the offer, the result and the new pack when accepted; the days to answer and the phones fill in by themselves.
One row per pause request: the member, the reason and the dates; the days paused, the fee for them, the phase and the phones fill in by themselves.
One row per request to refund, transfer or extend a pack, card or membership: the client, the request, the amount and the status; the days open and the phones fill in. Check your own local rules.
Prepaid sales by seller and month
One row per seller and month with at least one sale: packs, cards and memberships sold and their value; the average sale fills in by itself.
Daily takings with prepaid sold and used
One row per trading day: prepaid sold (packs, cards and membership fees) and prepaid used, cash, card and bank transfer; the money taken and the net prepaid fill in by themselves.
One row per client with visits and the preferred technician; the active packs, the sessions left, the prepaid value owed to them and the membership fill in from the other sheets.
Visits of clients with prepaid items
A sample of visits of clients who hold a pack, membership or card, with the payment method; the prepaid flag and the phones fill in by themselves.
The 20 services with minutes and price; the number of pack sessions taken for each fills in from Package Sessions.
Team and outside contacts with prepaid figures
The owner, technicians, front desk and outside contacts (a booth renter is a technician who rents a chair and keeps their own takings); the prepaid figures used in owner messages fill in.
